entries.description: Locked feed crux with owner via AskUserQuestion: public/open audience, permanent public IDs acceptable, anonymous-read required, GitHub Packages available but no nuget.org account yet.

Extracted package surface (15 IDs), internal dependency graph, confirmed DabblerPdf 1.1.2 already public on nuget.org (Reports.* closure resolves anonymously; LGPL/MPL copyleft transitive), template nuget.config no-source-mapping footgun, template hard-depends on Dabbler.Platform.Stubs.
Authored orchestrator (Opus) panel contribution directly with full repo context (session-1-review/opus.md).
Dispatched self-contained architecture prompt to GPT-5.4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro via call_model.
Synthesized the tri-provider verdict into feed-publication-decision.md; resolved the one divergence (GPT-5.4 stub exclusion) via local ground truth (template hard-dependency).
Authored ai-assignment.md from routed analysis.
Cross-provider session-verification by GPT-5.4: VERDICT VERIFIED, no Critical/Major; 3 Minor (presentation) findings addressed in the decision doc.
Cross-provider session-verification by GPT-5.4: VERDICT VERIFIED, no Critical/Major; 3 Minor (presentation) findings addressed in the decision doc.
Confirmed Session 2 prerequisites with the owner: nuget.org publisher account exists, scoped Dabbler.* API key exists, and a protected GitHub Environment contains NUGET_API_KEY.
Updated tools/pack.ps1 for publish CI: clean-output mode, scratch-cache reset, optional warnings-as-errors, and explicit PackAsDependency packing.
Authored .github/workflows/nuget-publish.yml: nuget-v* tag trigger for nuget.org publication with artifact promotion plus workflow_dispatch dry-run publication to GitHub Packages.

Carried forward the Session 1 guardrails in the workflow: SemVer tag parsing, clean temp package output, package artifact checks, consumer smoke tests, protected publish environment, and --skip-duplicate pushes.

Validated the publish path locally: tools/pack.ps1 succeeded against tmp/nuget-publish-validation, Dabbler.PublicSurface.Tests passed, and Dabbler.Packaging.Smoke passed against the staged artifacts (excluding the runtime LocalDB smoke gate).

Opus took over and fixed 4 CI-environment-only failures: tag-regex double-anchor; full-solution build pulling AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright's sibling-repo feed (added Dabbler.Publish.slnf solution filter); two packable libs not .sln members so pack --no-build failed (direct builds); .slnx + inline --source URL restore quirk (nuget.config).

Switched auth from NUGET_API_KEY secret to OIDC trusted publishing (NuGet/login@v1, id-token: write); renamed workflow to build.yml to match the policy. Owner created the trusted-publishing policy and pushed the tag; all 15 Dabbler.* packages (+ snupkg) published to nuget.org at 0.1.0-preview.1 (every push Created). Owner accepted the full set.

Cross-provider session-verification by Gemini 2.5 Pro: ISSUES_FOUND, no Critical. Dispositioned: Major#2 (downgrade SDK to 8.0.x) REJECTED as false positive (platform targets net10.0; pre-.NET-10 knowledge cutoff); Major#1 (SHA-pin actions) accepted as deferred hardening follow-up; Minor#2 (workflow name) applied; Minor#1 (loop vs wildcard) declined. No blocking defects.
dabbler-app nuget.config -> feed-only (<clear/> + nuget.org); removed local ./packages source + packages/.gitkeep; Web Dockerfile dropped COPY packages/ (kept COPY nuget.config).

Rewrote template README (NuGet packages & versions + Offline restore) and consumer-readiness.md (status->published; Local-Feed-Only limitation RESOLVED; consumer next-steps reframed). getting-started.md already feed-based. .gitignore comment refreshed.

Clean-machine consumer-validation gate GREEN: packed updated template, installed, scaffolded dabbler-app outside repo, confirmed feed-only nuget.config + no packages/ dir, cleared http-cache + built with isolated NUGET_PACKAGES; 12 Dabbler.* (+DabblerPdf) restored from nuget.org; build + scaffolded bUnit test passed.
Cross-provider session-verification (Gemini 2.5 Pro, cross-provider to Opus orchestrator): VERIFIED, zero Critical/Major.
Authored end-of-set change-log.md; noted downstream Dabbler.NorthwindToBlazor vendoring cleanup unblocked. Final session: set status flips to complete.
